deviations.description: Replace meta-builder-agent.md's task-creation write with one state-write.sh --allocate-into call
deviations.reason: The existing Stage 6 design precomputed all task numbers upfront (base_num + position) before any write, which is structurally incompatible with --allocate-into's derive-the-number-inside-the-mutex-at-write-time contract (the precomputed number could go stale between the read and the write). Converted to incremental per-task allocation: task_number_map is now populated as each task is actually written (read back by slug), and later tasks' dependency arrays resolve against already-written tasks' real numbers. Same treatment applied to skill-fix-it's next_num/learn_it_task_num.
